software.optimizer: native Julia Optim.NelderMead deterministic starts, finite-difference Optim.BFGS refinement

source_model_spec.geometry_layout: rows selected physical3,4,5; columns array x,y,z metres
source_model_spec.rotation: SO(3), Rz*Ry*Rx; array to camera; both x right,y up,z forward
source_model_spec.caveat: Far-field planar direction-only model. Array cannot resolve front/back or range; near-field curvature, refraction and propagation paths are unmodelled.
source_model_spec.front_branch: array +z only; camera Z>0; impossible TDOAs invalid without clamping

estimator_spec.output: raw reference-relative sample delays; fitted offsets and rotation applied later by project_tdoas exactly once

parameters.delay_sign: positive means channel later than reference, dt_i=-(r_i-r_ref) dot u /1540 * fs
parameters.lag_limit: sensor pair distance/c*fs + 2 samples; ceil lag*8, capped at Nup/2-1
parameters.grid_equation: u,v in -1:sind(1):1, u^2+v^2<=1; positive array z branch
parameters.lag_interpolation: original curve_at linear interpolation with endpoint range guard; grid steering always physically feasible
parameters.geometry: D3 equilateral side0.18m; selected physical3,4,5; ref selected3/physical5
parameters.fft: DSP.nextfastfft(2L); R=X*conj(Y); high-frequency spectrum zero padding to N*8; original normalized irfft
parameters.refinement: 21x21 offsets range(-sind(1),sind(1)); strict > updates around coarse winner
parameters.snippets: read_event_snippet(...;verify=true): exact preparation-filtered cache bytes; original HP1kHz fourth-order filtfilt; inclusive -300:700 window; exact cached clipping/cross-file context retained
parameters.projection: Every method uses frozen evaluation_calibration through project_tdoas once; its relative-delay correction and rotation are applied once. No method-specific fit or heldout tuning.
parameters.departure_from_original: Silent/nonfinite/missing-channel snippets are explicit invalid estimates rather than arbitrary first-grid directions. Valid nonzero finite snippets use original fixed formulation.
parameters.score: mean of three normalized pair curves at winning physical direction; diagnostic, not probability or sound-speed truth

estimator_spec.input: Float64 samples x selected physical3,4,5; already fourth-order zero-phase HP1000 filtered, matching preparation

deployment_fit_scope: selected method, all frozen eligible annotations after frozen training selection and reused evaluation; in-sample deployment errors
robust_objective: bounded smooth transform cap*rho/(cap+rho) of pseudo-Huber rho, cap set at residual max(8delta,0.05 image diagonal); invalid rays contribute fixed cap; definitely-impossible observations screened only from objective and retained in coverage
